title: Visit to the Pantex pits

tellings.quote: and and I've been in Pantex. I've been down in the pits.

plain: In the 1980s, John S. Herrington, who was then US Secretary of Energy, went to the Pantex plant in Texas, a site under his department, and says he went "down in the pits" there. He tells Michels this himself: "I've been in Pantex. I've been down in the pits." He brings it up to show how close he came to the most secret parts of the places he oversaw.
